references.U0: SRC|U original continuous source task scores by seed; hcal pinned model manifest
references.Ucal: SRC|U|H-GLOBAL-TEMP continuous source scores with hcal global calibration by seed
references.F: FOCUSED full-83 purpose heads, same architecture/training/calibration family as all masked heads, per seed

fitting_local_guard.T_identity: AUC-free TASK_TABLE/T receipt durably written before FIT SEX read

eligibility: Each control independently passes every task accuracy/NLL/Brier point cap against U0,Ucal,F on every evaluated seed and matches both recipient profile capacities; attribution also requires J's actual union group count and encoded width. An exact alias remains eligible.
strongest_rule: Within each pool choose the eligible rule with the lowest paired-seed mean frozen-reader-envelope coalition AUC; only exact numerical equality uses listed rule order. Never require a distinct mask or release.

inference.resampling_unit: whole INNER_SELECTION group, same draw across all arms and seeds
inference.family: J-versus-each of all nine registered control rules coalition and two local clauses plus every J/control task/reference utility clause, registered before scoring; invalid/missing arms remain UNRESOLVED slots, all defined clauses enter two-sided 95% max-absolute-studentized bounds and complete fixed-reader envelopes are recomputed inside each draw

promotion: At most one J configuration after seeds 0 and 1; every seed must meet all three references' point utility caps for both tasks and both local no-worsening point caps against the main strongest eligible control selected on paired screen seeds. Attribution winner is reported but is not an additional nomination gate. A crossing interval alone is not a veto. If no eligible J, no seed-2 finalist.
joint_attribution: Requires simultaneous lower-bound coalition benefit at least 0.020 over both sequential orders and the strongest non-joint rule, with all utility and local caps retained.
